purpose: Issue #172's actual public-registry publication of the two beta.5 changed packages, dispatched with publish=true after docs/releases/evidence/beta.5/publication-revalidation.json passed. Each run required and received the protected environment's maintainer approval (milocosmopolitan) before its publish job executed; no automation bypassed that gate.

packages.name: agent-topology-langgraph
packages.registryPreflight: verify_spec_registry.py ran inside the publish job (per docs/releasing.md's producer registry preflight): resolved the prepared agent-topology-spec bound, installed agent-topology-spec==0.1.0b4 from public PyPI in a fresh venv, confirmed the installed version, installed the qualified langgraph wheel, and ran scripts/smoke_langgraph_installation.py against that combination -- all before npm publish uploaded anything.
packages.verification: curl https://pypi.org/pypi/agent-topology-langgraph/0.1.0b5/json -- both file digests are byte-identical to docs/releases/evidence/beta.5/python-langgraph-qualification.json's recorded sha256 values, confirming the exact locally-qualified wheel/sdist were uploaded with no rebuild.

packages.name: @agent-topology/langgraph
packages.registryPreflight: verify_npm_registry_peer.mjs ran inside the qualify/publish sequence per docs/releasing.md: read the prepared @agent-topology/spec peer (0.1.0-beta.4), confirmed that exact version was already public on npm, clean-installed it from the registry together with the already-qualified producer tarball (no workspace links, no local support tarball), and ran a minimal public-API smoke -- before npm publish uploaded anything.
packages.peerDependency: @langchain/langgraph@1.4.14 (runtime dependency, exact); @agent-topology/spec@0.1.0-beta.4 (declared peer/compatible version, unchanged from beta.4, already public)
packages.verification: Downloaded the published tarball from https://registry.npmjs.org/@agent-topology/langgraph/-/langgraph-0.1.0-beta.5.tgz and independently computed sha256 (138ff62729f623bcf441b75ecb4ae06f82ba564a57d8fe7884c9fcc7b98c5e5c, matches docs/releases/evidence/beta.5/npm-langgraph-qualification.json exactly) and sha512 (matches the registry's own recorded `integrity` field exactly), confirming byte-for-byte the same tarball qualified by #171 was uploaded with no rebuild. `npm view` dist-tags show `beta` -> 0.1.0-beta.5; `latest` remains 0.1.0-beta.1, unmoved, per policy of never advancing the default dist-tag for a prerelease.
